items.title: 8.2 Podon mein gaison ka tabadla (gas exchange) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 8.2, printed pages 180-182.

blocks.text: Stomata (wahid stoma) podon ke tissues mein nanhe surakh (pores) hain jo gaison ke tabadle (exchange) ke liye zaroori hain. Yeh aam taur par patton mein hote hain magar kuch tanon (stems) mein bhi mil sakte hain. Har stoma ke gird khaas guard cells hote hain jo surakh kholte aur band karte hain; guard cells lobiya (bean) ki shakal ke hain, chloroplasts rakhte hain, aur mahol ke halaat par radd-e-amal karte hain. Stomata ka khulna aur band hona transpiration ki raftar qaboo karta hai.

Din ki roshni mein stomata khulte hain taake photosynthesis ke liye CO2 andar aaye, aur un ka khulna guard cells ke zariye tai hota hai. Raat ko, jab roshni na hone se photosynthesis ruk jati hai, stomata aam taur par pani bachane ke liye band ho jate hain, agarche poda phir bhi saans (respiration) leta hai, O2 andar leta aur CO2 nikalta hai. Raat ko stomata band karne se transpiration se pani ka ziyan kam se kam hota hai.
Stomata ka khulna aur band hona

Guard cells kai-hissi (multisensory) hydraulic valves ka kaam karte hain. Un ke khulne aur band hone ki do mafroozay (hypotheses) wazahat karti hain: starch-sugar hypothesis aur potassium ions ka dakhla (influx).

1856 mein German maahir-e-nabatat (botanist) H. von Mohl ne tajweez kiya ke patte ki epidermis ke cells mein sirf guard cells photosynthesis karte hain aur din mein sugars banate hain. Jaise guard cells mein sugar ki concentration barhti hai, un ka water potential girta hai; pani andar aata hai, cells phool kar turgid ho jate hain aur stoma khul jata hai. Raat ko photosynthesis rukti hai, sugars na-hal-pazeer (insoluble) starch mein badal jati ya respiration mein istemal ho jati hain, azaad sugars kam hoti hain, pani bahar jata hai, guard cells turgor kho kar dheele (flaccid) ho jate hain aur stoma band kar dete hain. Magar yeh mechanism stomata ki harkat ke dauran guard cells ke turgor ki tez tabdeeliyon ki poori wazahat nahin karta.

Stomata ka khulna potassium ions (K+) ke guard cells mein faal naqal (active transport) se hota hai, jo un ka osmotic potential gira deta hai. Pani osmosis se peeche aata hai, guard cells turgid hote hain aur stoma khulta hai. Neeli roshni mahol ko tezabi bana kar is amal ko barhati hai, jo K+ lene aur pani jazb karne ko tez karta hai. Raat ko K+ guard cells se ghair-faal taur par bahar diffuse hota hai, pani nikal jata hai, cells flaccid hote hain aur stoma band ho jata hai.

blocks.title: Hormones aur stomata
blocks.text: Hormones stomata ki harkat mein hissa lete hain. Zyada darja-hararat (temperature) par, jab patte ke cells murjhane lagte hain, mesophyll cells hormone abscisic acid chhorte hain. Yeh guard cells mein K+ ki active transport rok deta hai, roshni aur CO2 concentration ke asrat par ghalib aa jata hai, to K+ pumping ruk jati hai aur stomata band ho jate hain.
Palisade tissue aur gaison ka rasta

Palisade tissue patte ki oopri epidermis ke theek neeche hota hai. Yeh lambe, kas kar jure cells par mushtamil hai jo chloroplasts se bharpoor hain aur is tarah tarteeb mein hain ke roshni ka jazb zyada se zyada ho, taake poda roshni ki tawanai ko kimiyai tawanai mein moassar tareeqe se badle. Fiza se carbon dioxide stomata ke zariye patte mein diffuse hoti hai, spongy mesophyll ki hawa ki jagahon se guzar kar palisade cells tak pohnchti hai, aur photosynthesis mein istemal hoti hai. Bani hui oxygen palisade cells se spongy mesophyll ke raste wapas diffuse ho kar stomata se bahar nikal jati hai.

blocks.alt: Patte ka cross-section: oopri epidermis par momi cuticle, chloroplasts se bhare lambe palisade cells ki qatar, hawa ki jagahon wale dheele gol spongy cells, aur neechli epidermis jis mein stoma ke gird lobiya ki shakal ke do guard cells; teer carbon dioxide ka dakhla aur oxygen aur pani ka nikalna dikhate hain. Inset: turgid guard cells ke beech khula stoma aur flaccid cells ke beech band.
blocks.caption: Patte ki banawat aur stoma ka khulna aur band hona (Figures 8.4 aur 8.5 ke mutabiq asal diagram).
blocks.long_description: Cuticle aur oopri epidermis kas kar jure, chloroplast se bharpoor cells ki palisade tah ko dhanpte hain jahan zyada tar photosynthesis hoti hai, jis ke neeche hawa ki jagahon wali spongy tah hai. Neechli epidermis mein chloroplasts wale lobiya-numa do guard cells har stoma ko gherte hain. Carbon dioxide stoma aur hawa ki jagahon se palisade cells tak diffuse hoti hai, aur oxygen aur pani ke bukharat isi raste nikalte hain. Jab K+ aur pani guard cells mein aate hain to woh turgid ho kar stoma kholte hain; jab nikalte hain to cells flaccid ho kar stoma band kar dete hain.

blocks.prompt: Wazahat karein ke garam dopahar mein murjhata patta apne stomata kyun band kar leta hai jab ke roshni aur CO2 ke halaat khulne ke haq mein hain.
blocks.explanation: Murjhate patte ke mesophyll cells abscisic acid chhorte hain, jo guard cells mein K+ ki active transport rok deta hai. K+ ke dakhle ke baghair pani nahin aata, guard cells turgor kho kar flaccid ho jate hain, aur stomata band ho jate hain, roshni aur CO2 ke asrat par ghalib aa kar.

items: Stomata surakh hain, zyada tar patton mein, lobiya-numa chloroplast wale do guard cells ke beech; din mein CO2 ke liye khulte aur raat ko pani bachane ko band hote hain, transpiration qaboo karte hain.

Starch-sugar hypothesis: din mein guard cell sugars barhti hain, water potential girta hai to pani aata hai aur cells turgid hote hain. K+ influx: K+ ki active transport (neeli roshni se tez) pani kheenchti hai; raat ko K+ nikal jata hai. Murjhate patton mein abscisic acid K+ pumping rok deta hai.
Oopri epidermis ke neeche palisade cells chloroplasts se bhare hain; CO2 stomata aur spongy hawa ki jagahon se un tak pohnchti hai, aur O2 isi raste nikalti hai.
